essence: The goddess holds sovereign power over both the arising and the removal of suffering.
The goddess transcends fear while wielding and eliminating it.
The goddess embodies the creation, performance, and enjoyment of melody.
The nectar of youth fully satisfies and nourishes the goddess.
The goddess perfectly embodies both the qualities and eloquence of youth.
